Job Description:

Client is setting up an Agents Factory (based on copilot studio) and will need an expert
on both Copilot Studio & Azure AI Foundry scope (part of Azure AI).
The objective is to build complex retrieval/action/autonomous agents and globally
system of agents.
An expert who can manage the technology and possesses strong soft skills (clear
communication, problem-solving explanations, and bot descriptions).
Co-Pilot agents' categories, agentic systems, or describe the use cases for both Low
Code agents and Pro Dev Azure AI.



Main requirements from:

Experience with Data: Experience in data analysis, machine learning, and AI
technologies (Ex: developing AI models and integrating them with Power Apps).
Knowledge of Power Automate.
Ideally with knowledge about AI Driven Power Apps. experienced in AI and Power
Automate
Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze complex
business requirements
Skill with Power automates
AI builder Skill

This role is not part of RPA of power automate but required to work with the team
